Hi Jordan / Samantha,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to propose a couple of times for a 45-minute live demo of Redwood Inference focused on:

- High-level serving architecture and security posture (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
- Latency/cost tradeoffs for your batch vs. interactive loads
- Dedicated vs. hosted options and migration path

Proposed times (PT):
- Tuesday 2026-07-14, 10:00-10:45
- Wednesday 2026-07-15, 14:00-14:45

If neither works, happy to send an invite for a 30-minute overview. I've attached a short agenda and some materials that might be helpful before the call.

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Next steps: let me know which time works or if you prefer a different week.

Thanks,

Ben,

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials. I wanted to give you a quick update — leadership just re-prioritized our roadmap for the rest of H2 and the LLM/inference initiative has been pushed down the list while we focus on a payments migration and a couple of merchant-facing reliability items.

Given that, we need to pause active demos and vendor evaluations for now. Sorry to do this on short notice — there are travel conflicts and internal bandwidth constraints driving the decision.

Can we park this and I'll reach back out when we're ready to pick it up again (likely October/early Q4)? If helpful, we'd be open to a 15-minute check-in in late September to see if timelines shifted.

Thanks for understanding.

—Jordan
